ui.ascension.tab.ascension.hint: Pick 1 of 2 subclasses and spend the points on its mini-tree (free to change).
ui.ascension.help:
Statue of Time
TRIALS: levels 30, 40 and 50, in order. Spikes: −HP every second. Time Pulse (violet): when it glows it sends you back to the start of the floor. The first time, each player in the group earns their 2 points.
ASCENSION: 6 points in total (2 per Trial), 10 worth of cost in the tree: choose.
